guideContent: Editors can edit content and attachments across Knowledge and Drafts, including home and category pages. In Knowledge, choose Edit content to open the linked draft. Save draft and preview, check the rendered page, then Submit for review. The published page changes only after approval. The submitter can withdraw a pending request. Reviewers approve and publish or return it for changes; the submitter cannot review their own work. Published working copies stay hidden until editing resumes. Editors can update the writing-area home directly. Administrators manage category definitions, permissions, users and system configuration.
uploadInvalid: Enter an integer from 1 to 99999 MB.
aboutContent:
LuxPedia is a private knowledge platform for finding, maintaining and sharing team knowledge. AI retrieval and online Office editing are not yet connected.

The wiki uses XWiki Standard 17.10.15 LTS (LGPL 2.1 or later), PostgreSQL 16.15 (PostgreSQL License) and Publication Workflow 2.4.9. The difference between the workflow extension’s published license metadata and repository wording is documented in docs/components.md and docs/workflow.md.

LuxPedia is the name of this instance. Upstream source files, NOTICE and LICENSE files, component identifiers and administration interfaces retain their original notices. Copyright remains with the respective rights holders. Branding does not change licensing or authorization checks.
